task_definition: From all nine known included primary reports, extract every source-supported all-cause mortality record involving remdesivir. Preserve competing remdesivir durations, comparator identity, follow-up, and any source facts that later affect analysis. Do not select the main-analysis evidence here.
source_policy: Use only listed source documents. Target reviews and evaluator artifacts are forbidden.

representation_tracks.pdf_only: Obtain the listed publications separately. No PDF, OCR, or parsed text is redistributed.

evaluation.source_support: Evaluator adjudication with a source quotation
